"/></div><div class="solution"><div class="label">FIRST LOOK</div><h4>有二极管就分状态</h4><div class="exam-flow"><span class="flow-label">判断</span><p>先假设二极管导通或截止，在该状态下用运放规则求解，再回头检查假设是否成立。</p></div><div class="sop"><span class="flow-label">步骤</span><div>求 u+ → 假设状态 → 列式求解 → 检查条件 → 必要时切换状态</div></div><div class="exam-tip"><span class="flow-label">易错</span><div>分段题一定要“求完再验”，不能只凭方向判断。</div></div><div class="score-tip"><span class="flow-label">得分提醒</span>分段题每个区间都要“假设 → 求解 → 验证”，只凭二极管方向猜状态容易少一个区间。</div><details><summary>关键结果</summary><div class="inner"><p>卷面给出的分段结果：<span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">u<sub>i</sub>≥0</span> 时，<span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">u<sub>o</sub>=3u<sub>i</sub>/2</span>；<span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">u<sub>i</sub>&lt;0</span> 时，二极管截止，<span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">u<sub>o</sub>=0</span>。</p></div></details></div></div></article>
<article class="exam"><div class="exam-head"><div class="exam-title"><h3>2020–2021 A卷 · 第2题</h3><div class="tagrow"><span class="tag">同相比例</span><span class="tag">±6V 限幅</span><span class="tag">输出波形</span></div></div><div class="score">10 分 · 传输+波形</div></div><div class="exam-body"><div class="original"><img alt="2020-2021 A卷 第2题" decoding="async" loading="lazy" src="data:image/webp;base64,"/></div><div class="solution"><div class="label">FIRST LOOK</div><h4>先画传输特性，再映射输入波形</h4><div class="exam-flow"><span class="flow-label">判断</span><p>线性段仍是 u_o=2u_i，输出被限制在 ±6 V；先得到传输特性，再把正弦输入逐段映射到输出。</p></div><div class="sop"><span class="flow-label">步骤</span><div>求线性关系 → 加限幅 → 画传输特性 → 映射输入波形</div></div><div class="exam-tip"><span class="flow-label">易错</span><div>画波形前先把拐点标出来，避免凭感觉截顶。</div></div><div class="score-tip"><span class="flow-label">得分提醒</span>先把传输特性画出来，再把输入波形映射过去；直接凭感觉画输出最容易在限幅拐点出错。</div><details><summary>关键结果</summary><div class="inner"><p>卷面结果：传输特性中间段 <span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">u<sub>o</sub>=2u<sub>i</sub></span>，限幅 <span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">±6 V</span>；对 <span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">u<sub>i</sub>=3sinωt</span>，输出峰值为 <span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">±6 V</span>。</p></div></details></div></div></article>
<article class="exam"><div class="exam-head"><div class="exam-title"><h3>2021–2022 B卷 · 第6题</h3><div class="tagrow"><span class="tag">两级运放</span><span class="tag">减法器</span><span class="tag">电阻条件</span></div></div><div class="score">10 分 · 综合运算</div></div><div class="exam-body"><div class="original"><img alt="2021-2022 B卷 第6题" decoding="async" loading="lazy" src="data:image/webp;base64,"/></div><div class="solution"><div class="label">FIRST LOOK</div><h4>多级运放：一级一级拆</h4><div class="exam-flow"><span class="flow-label">判断</span><p>先求 A1 的中间输出，再把 A2 当反相加法器，用叠加关系合并各路输入。</p></div><div class="sop"><span class="flow-label">步骤</span><div>求 A1 → 写 A2 各路贡献 → 叠加 → 整理系数 → 约束电阻关系</div></div><div class="exam-tip"><span class="flow-label">易错</span><div>复杂图先分块，不要一次把所有节点塞进一个方程。</div></div><div class="score-tip"><span class="flow-label">得分提醒</span>多级运放按一级一级写中间量，最后代回总输出；一上来列总方程反而最容易丢符号。</div><details><summary>关键结果</summary><div class="inner"><p>卷面推导：<span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">u<sub>o</sub>=(R<sub>2</sub>R<sub>5</sub>)/(R<sub>1</sub>R<sub>4</sub>)u<sub>11</sub>−(R<sub>5</sub>/R<sub>3</sub>)u<sub>12</sub></span>。要成为两个输入信号的减法器，应使两系数等幅，即 <span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">R<sub>2</sub>R<sub>3</sub>=R<sub>1</sub>R<sub>4</sub></span>。</p></div></details></div></div></article>
<article class="exam"><div class="exam-head"><div class="exam-title"><h3>2021–2022 B卷 · 第9题</h3><div class="tagrow"><span class="tag">迟滞比较器</span><span class="tag">双门限</span><span class="tag">传输特性</span><span class="tag">输出波形</span></div></div><div class="score">12 分 · 压轴变式</div></div><div class="exam-body"><div class="original"><img alt="2021-2022 B卷 第9题" decoding="async" loading="lazy" src="data:image/webp;base64,
